children: Meta is working toward building a platform for Muse agents to coordinate with each other on their users' behalf. The platform, which CEO Mark Zuckerberg refers to as Muse Network, is based on the belief "that billions of Muses in a network at scale will be able to get more done for people and businesses by working together," Zuckerberg says on an earnings call. "We'd like to create a large scale Muse Network as quickly as possible." (elias.schisgall@wsj.com)
